Many of my students may have new laptop when they get to campus. We use @glitch in my classes which will not run Edge. Our university policy is to also encourage students to only use Firefox....

We hit this this sreen a few times yesterday on Windows 10 machines

Microsoft by default throws shade on Firefox for being slow and unsafe. This isn't true, it is a lie...and WTF is "S Mode" how is a consumer supposed to know what that is?
